item.title: Producer Surplus and Consumer Surplus
item.description:
When discussing economics, Producer Surplus is an important concept. It refers to the difference between the actual income received by a producer or supplier when selling goods in the market at a certain price, and the minimum income they expected when willing to sell those goods at that price.

Simply put, Producer Surplus is the net gain of the producer in a transaction. Its calculation involves two key factors:

Producer’s Supply Price: This refers to the price at which the producer is willing to sell the goods or services. Typically, the producer’s supply price is related to their marginal cost (the extra cost of producing one unit of goods), because they hope to at least cover the production cost.
item.content:encoded:
When discussing economics, Producer Surplus is an important concept. It refers to the difference between the actual income received by a producer or supplier when selling goods in the market at a certain price, and the minimum income they expected when willing to sell those goods at that price.

Simply put, Producer Surplus is the net gain of the producer in a transaction. Its calculation involves two key factors:

Producer’s Supply Price: This refers to the price at which the producer is willing to sell the goods or services. Typically, the producer’s supply price is related to their marginal cost (the extra cost of producing one unit of goods), because they hope to at least cover the production cost.

Market Price: This refers to the price the buyer is willing to pay, which is the market price of the goods or services.

The calculation formula for Producer Surplus is as follows:

Producer Surplus = Producer’s Supply Price - Market Price

Producer Surplus represents the net gain obtained by the producer when selling goods at a lower supply price. Producer Surplus occurs when the market price is higher than the producer’s supply price, because the producer sells the goods at a lower price but receives a higher actual income. If the market price is lower than the producer’s supply price, the Producer Surplus will be negative, meaning the producer may incur a loss in the transaction.

Producer Surplus is very important for understanding market operation and the supply-demand relationship. In a free market, the balance of supply and demand determines the market price, and Producer Surplus helps us understand the producer’s profitability at different price levels. When the market is in equilibrium, Producer Surplus is maximized, meaning the producer achieves maximum profit.

Okay, Consumer Surplus is an economic term that refers to the economic benefit or value obtained by consumers when purchasing goods or services. Its calculation method is:

Consumer Surplus = Consumer’s Reservation Price (Expected Price) - Actual Paid Price

For a simple example, assume the reservation price for an item is 100 Yuan for the consumer. If the actual market price is 80 Yuan, then the Consumer Surplus obtained by that consumer when purchasing the item is 100 - 80 = 20 Yuan.

Consumer Surplus reflects the net gain obtained by the consumer after purchasing goods or services. The larger the Consumer Surplus, the higher the economic utility obtained by the consumer. Increasing Consumer Surplus can usually raise total social welfare. The government employs many measures to increase Consumer Surplus, such as subsidies, tax incentives, etc.

item.title: What should I do if I want to earn profit beyond the value of the labor itself?
item.description: In a free competitive market, when the wage level of a certain profession or industry is higher than the value deserved by the labor output or skills for that job, it attracts more people to study that profession and enter that market. As the supply increases, the number of workers in the market grows, which subsequently causes the wage level to decrease, eventually approaching the value deserved by the labor output.
item.content:encoded:
In a free competitive market, when the wage level of a certain profession or industry is higher than the value deserved by the labor output or skills for that job, it attracts more people to study that profession and enter that market. As the supply increases, the number of workers in the market grows, which subsequently causes the wage level to decrease, eventually approaching the value deserved by the labor output.

This phenomenon is known in economics as the “Marginal Productivity Theory.” It posits that there is a relationship between the wage level and the marginal output of labor (which is the increase in output generated by adding one unit of labor). When a certain profession’s wage is higher than its marginal output, it attracts more people to join, thereby increasing the labor supply, which in turn lowers the wage level until the marginal output and the wage level reach equilibrium.

This phenomenon is common across many professions and industries. When supply and demand in the market tend towards equilibrium, the wage level usually tends towards the value of the marginal output—this is the situation you mentioned where profit approaches zero. In the long run, the market forms a relatively stable equilibrium state, and the wage level adjusts to match the skills, labor output, and market demand.

This also explains why continuous learning and skill improvement are extremely important for individuals to achieve success and obtain better compensation in the workplace. By constantly improving one’s skills and knowledge, an individual can maintain competitiveness in a fierce market and achieve better economic returns.

If you wish to earn extra profit beyond the value of the labor itself in the labor market, you can consider the following strategies:

Differentiation and Specialization: Find the field or specific skill you excel in, and continuously refine it to become an expert. Through differentiation and specialization, you can provide higher quality and more specialized services, thereby creating higher market value for yourself.

Creating Unique Value: Identify the pain points or needs in the market and provide unique solutions. Understand the customer’s true needs and offer services that exceed their expectations. This can win you more customers and positive word-of-mouth, leading to extra profit beyond the value of the labor itself.

Building a Personal Brand: Establish your visibility and authority in the industry through effective branding and personal promotion. A reputable and credible personal brand can bring you more business opportunities and chances, potentially leading to higher returns.

Mastering Composite Skills: Learning and mastering skills across multiple fields allows you to become a versatile individual. Possessing multiple skills increases your flexibility and adaptability, better meeting market demands, which brings you more opportunities and potential profits.

Innovation and Leadership: Continuously innovating and leading teams to achieve goals can bring you more business opportunities and project collaborations, thereby creating extra profit for you.

It is important to emphasize that pursuing extra profit beyond the value of the labor itself is not easy; it requires a significant investment of time, effort, and resources. Furthermore, success is not achieved overnight; it requires continuous effort and ongoing learning and growth. The key is to find the development path and strategy that suits you and continuously optimize and adjust it through practice. In a fiercely competitive market, only by continuously enhancing your value can you gain more opportunities and profits in the workplace.

item.title: The relationship between workers and large companies is that the company hopes you become a replaceable cog in the machine.
item.description: The company hopes you become a screw/cog, a replaceable part. You hope to be irreplaceable, even possessing the ability to generate independent profit, becoming a company unto yourself. Therefore, only at certain stages will the interests and goals of both parties align; after that stage, you should separate.

item.title: Everyone can use English
item.description:
The outcome of merely “studying” without “applying” (which is the reality for most Chinese students) is that even after more than a decade, they are still studying and still useless (this is the reality for most Chinese students).

The reason we “study for a lifetime” yet insist on “never applying it for a lifetime” is because we are afraid of making mistakes. When we make mistakes in childhood, they often lead to punishment. In adulthood, even if there is no punishment from others, there is still the self-deprecation and embarrassment caused by making a mistake. Therefore, many people avoid errors “at all costs.” However, we must know that the process of acquiring knowledge cannot be separated from trial and error. Without trial and error, comprehensive and genuine progress is impossible. So, you must know that making mistakes is normal, and it is even indispensable. When doing something, making mistakes is inevitable. If you are doing something and there isn’t a single mistake, then you aren’t doing something—you are dreaming.

There are many benefits to being able to read English fluently. The word “freedom” basically summarizes the greatest benefit. For example, we can read primary source materials directly, without having to wait a long time to read translations that are often riddled with errors. Translations are often unreliable because translation is truly, truly a difficult job. Often, when a translation is unreliable, it’s not the fault of the translator; at least, a portion of the language is fundamentally untranslatable. If you can read English fluently, you will inevitably laugh when reading a translation—many sentences are translated incorrectly, and you can even reconstruct the original English in your mind based on experience. Not relying on translation is a tremendous liberation. When your English reading reaches a certain level of proficiency, you will naturally feel grateful; it is a gratitude worth a thousand pieces of gold. However, we haven’t reached that point yet. As for the present, whether you believe it or not is up to you.

Not Knowing Yourself

—Because Chinese nouns do not distinguish between singular and plural, and Chinese verbs do not have tenses. After eliminating these two errors, it is equivalent to solving most of the problems.

“Consistency Relationship”: Subject-verb agreement, tense consistency between the main clause and the subordinate clause, active/passive relationship consistency between non-finite verbs and the logical subject, pronoun reference consistency, consistency of parallel component structure, etc.

As an English user, don’t be misled by English teachers. As a teacher, as part of an educational product, they naturally emphasize “correct,” “accurate,” and “standard”—regardless of whether they themselves are truly “correct,” “accurate,” or “standard.” Sometimes it is quite sad to think about; most teachers have to raise their standards not out of a desire for progress, but merely to meet the “consumer’s” often unreasonable expectations. English teachers are human, and thus most of them have the same psychological limitations or human limitations as most other people. When a person cannot do something, they pretend, and keep pretending until they truly believe it themselves.

Another important concern about not daring to speak English is being ridiculed by those around you. This is indeed annoying. But think about it: would a normal person ridicule a baby’s stumbling steps? No. Would a normal person ridicule a disabled person? No, and they shouldn’t. So look at it: if someone speaks a foreign language with non-standard or unpleasant pronunciation, is it reasonable for them to be ridiculed? If someone speaks a foreign language and carries an accent their whole life, unable to change it, is it reasonable for them to be ridiculed?

“Whether they understood” is not important here. The goal of significantly increasing auditory input is to rebuild speech recognition ability; the focus is not on textual comprehension ability. Babies have…

…already solidified the “Bilingual Speech Filter.” In fact, I highly suspect that various English early education programs consume too much time that could have been used to acquire other skills, thereby limiting the development of the young child’s brain. However, you cannot expect that just by listening to recordings or watching TV, a child will learn a foreign language.

—As long as you start, you will find that it is not difficult, because “even if you don’t understand, it doesn’t matter.” The more you listen, the longer you listen, sooner or later, it won’t be too hard to understand. Of course, even at the beginning, for better results, you can consciously gradually increase the text difficulty, and it is best to combine it with intensive reading. During this period, almost everyone will feel like there is no progress, but this…

Mulling Over (or Deep Thinking)

The most serious yet most hidden reason for most people failing to learn English might be this: most people have too high an expectation for short-term gains and too low an expectation for long-term gains.

In fact, most people find it difficult to read any sentence fluently in their native language—even though most people believe they can do it. For example, perhaps most people can read any sentence from Reader magazine relatively fluently without any preparation.

But these “quick reading” suggestions are basically treating the symptoms, not the root cause, because they only solve the problem of input speed, not the problem of comprehension speed after input. No matter how fast the input speed is, if the comprehension speed cannot keep up, what good is it? Sometimes you wonder why so many people clearly think in their minds that they want to improve…

  1. Picking up a dictionary and looking up words independently is one of the most direct and effective ways to improve reading comprehension.

  2. Those who don’t look up words—our bodies’ every organ possesses a certain “evolutionary ability” to some degree. If you play the piano for a long time, your fingers become more flexible; if you exercise consistently for a long time, your cardiorespiratory function becomes stronger; if you speak more than others, your tongue becomes more flexible than others.

The biggest difference between English teachers and students might be just one: English teachers must look up words in a dictionary (or other reference books, if there are others), while students have another option besides looking up dictionaries—participating in various courses. What do teachers do in English class? Actually, they mostly just tell the students the words and phrases they looked up the previous night, and the sentences they figured out after thinking about them using the dictionary (and other reference books). And the students? They listen. The students listen, but essentially, they do not participate in the process of reading comprehension.

If you meet a person who doesn’t understand that “love” and “marriage” are not the same, it is best to keep your distance, otherwise, a painful life “is waiting for you not far away”…

If you meet someone who doesn’t understand the difference between “government” and “country,” it is best not to communicate with them easily, otherwise, you might discover endless troubles and calamities because of it…

If you don’t know that “goal” and “plan” are not the same, and you don’t know that you might ultimately fail to achieve your goal because of “sticking to the plan”…

If you don’t know that “going to school” (上学) and “studying” (学习) are not the same, some of them might look down on people who graduated from vocational schools because they have a PhD; conversely, others might hate those with PhDs because they only have a vocational diploma…

If you don’t know the difference between “a person” and “a person’s view,” you might either blindly trust authority or consider yourself to be the absolute authority…

If you don’t know the difference between “Action” and “Reaction,” you might spend your whole life as a slave to your surroundings while remaining completely unconscious…

Many students hate history class; it is actually just that they haven’t understood the important difference between “history” and “a history book”…

Organizing vocabulary. You must know that organizing vocabulary yourself after reading an article is far more efficient than memorizing word lists—unfortunately, most people don’t believe it.

If a fifth-grade student can read independently for 10 minutes every day, they will read 622,000 more words per year than children who don’t read independently…

—Whether it is abstract or concrete. What are adjectives for? You use adjectives to record your perception of the thing you can sense. What about verbs? Verbs are used to record the action emitted by the thing you can sense. So, finally, adverbs? When adverbs modify verbs, they are used to record your perception of the action emitted by the thing you can sense; when adverbs modify adjectives, they are used to record your perception of the perception of the thing you can sense. (This minute’s content seems somewhat convoluted, but as long as you can accurately pause these words and understand them without error, you will be transformed in just one minute.)

“Concise, simple, effective, accurate, specific.” Of course, this is not an iron law; if you have the ability to explain the principle clearly with ornate words, that is not impossible; conversely, telling a moving story with simple language is also possible. But everyone who hopes that their thoughts can be effectively expressed should keep these ten words in mind.

item.title: Guide to Wealth and Happiness
item.description:
Pursue wealth, not money or status. Wealth refers to assets that continue to earn money for you while you sleep. Money is the way we convert time into wealth. Status is the position you hold in the social hierarchy. Note - Location 321 Social status is a zero-sum game.

Relying on renting out your time is impossible to get rich. You must own equity (a part of the company’s ownership) to achieve financial freedom.
item.content:encoded:
Pursue wealth, not money or status. Wealth refers to assets that continue to earn money for you while you sleep. Money is the way we convert time into wealth. Status is the position you hold in the social hierarchy. Note - Location 321 Social status is a zero-sum game.

Relying on renting out your time is impossible to get rich. You must own equity (a part of the company’s ownership) to achieve financial freedom.

One way to acquire wealth is to provide society with something it needs but cannot obtain, and then achieve scale.

To acquire wealth, you must fully utilize the leverage effect. Business leverage comes from capital, labor, and products whose marginal cost of replication is zero (code and media).

There is a large number of robots available for us to use for free. To improve thermal efficiency and save space, these robots are concentrated in data centers. Use them.

Study microeconomics, game theory, psychology, persuasion, ethics, mathematics, and computer science.

Set a bold personal hourly rate and strictly enforce it. If the cost saved by solving a problem is less than your hourly rate, ignore the problem; if the cost of outsourcing a task is less than your hourly rate, choose to outsource it.

What you truly want is wealth. Wealth is an asset that can make money for you even while you sleep. Wealth can be factories and robots that produce. Wealth can be computer programs that serve clients day and night. Wealth can also be money in the bank that is invested in other assets or businesses.

To make money in society, you must provide society with something it needs but cannot obtain. If society has already created the needed products and services, you will no longer be needed.

Through the internet, everyone can find their audience. As long as you engage in unique self-expression online, you have the opportunity to spread happiness, accumulate wealth, create products, and start businesses.[78]

The starting point is not important; the action itself is what matters. Therefore, adhering to moral standards is not easy.

If you do not hold company equity, the correlation between personal input and return will be very strong. Almost all salaried jobs, even high-paying professions like lawyers or doctors, require time input to earn corresponding income.

The first is labor leverage, which means having others work for you. Labor leverage is one of the oldest forms of leverage, but in modern society, its effectiveness is not the best.[1] I even think it is the most outdated form of leverage. Because managing others is a very complex and challenging job that requires superb leadership skills, the manager might end up being abandoned by their followers and devoured by their subordinates.[78]

Capital is the second, relatively better form of leverage. Capital leverage is using money to expand the influence of decisions.[1] Capital is a more modern form of leverage, and utilizing it has a certain difficulty, requiring certain skills. In the 20th century, people gained astonishing wealth by using capital leverage. Capital leverage was the main form of leverage in the 20th century.

And things like programming, writing books, recording podcasts, tweeting, and filming videos do not require permission from anyone. It can be seen that new leverage acts like an equalizer, greatly narrowing the gap between people and making society more equal.[78] For example, every excellent software developer now has a large group of robots working for them. After writing the code, these robots start working and earning money for the developer even while they sleep.[78] Relying on renting out your time can never lead to wealth.

One major goal of life should be to control your own time. The ideal job is one that utilizes the leverage effect. In this work model, you can control your time and be responsible for your output and results. If you bring a miraculous turning point to a company by providing excellent solutions, you will certainly receive financial rewards. Especially if others don’t even know how you did it, they must continuously pay you to continue providing that product or service. And the reason you can do this is because of your obsession, skill, or talent.

One other point that benefits me: I value freedom above all else. The freedom I speak of is diverse: the freedom to do what you want to do, the freedom not to do what you don’t want to do, the freedom from being influenced by self-emotions or external factors, etc. Freedom is the value I cherish the most.

To face reality, you must let go of the self, eliminate self-consciousness, forget self-judgment, and calm self-emotions. Although humans are advanced animals, the existence of emotional self-consciousness brings rumination, allowing certain desires to blind our eyes, making us unable to see reality clearly, and thus leading us to rashly judge “how the world should be.” This situation often occurs, especially when mixing political demands with business issues.

The difficulty lies in seeing the truth clearly. To see the truth clearly, you must escape the self, because the self does not want to face the truth. The weaker the self, the fewer the restrictions on its reactions, and the lower the obsession with the desired outcome, the easier it is to see reality clearly.

The craving for a beautiful reality blinds the perception of the real world. What is called suffering is the inability to continue ignoring the facts.

Note - Location 1130 The more you crave to solve a problem in a specific way, the less likely you are to see the facts clearly.

Without thinking, you won’t have outstanding business ideas, nor can you make correct judgments. I encourage everyone to spend at least one day a week thinking (preferably two days, because even if you allocate two days, it might end up being one).

Only a relaxed brain can generate great ideas. A person who feels immense pressure, is bogged down in paperwork, is constantly running around, and is stressed out cannot think. Therefore, you must make time for thinking.[7]

Almost all biases are designed to help people make quick judgments when information is incomplete. For important decisions, set aside memory and identity, and focus on the problem itself.

Bookmark - Location 1244

If it is difficult to choose, then the answer is negative.

The difference between people is not “educated” and “uneducated,” but “likes reading” and “dislikes reading.”

Read classic works in mathematics, science, and philosophy. Don’t read bestsellers, don’t watch the news. Avoid joining any so-called “book clubs,” avoid pursuing any social conformity. Place truth above social conformity.[11]

The reality is that life is a single-player game. A person is born alone, dies alone, and interprets everything in the world alone. Your memories belong only to you. Before you are born, no one cares; after you leave the world, no one cares. You exist in the world for only a few decades; life is a single-player game.

Essentially, the process of life is replacing bad habits formed unintentionally with well-cultivated good habits, striving to become a happier person. Your happiness index ultimately depends on your habits and the people you spend the most time with.

The more secrets you have, the lower your sense of happiness.[11]

The purpose of the news is to make people feel anxious and angry. But the science, economics, education, and conflict trends behind the news have positive significance. You must maintain a good state of mind and an optimistic attitude.[11]

item.title: Some useful risk management tools and risk management methods
item.description:
When dealing with risk management, there are many useful tools and methods that can help you reduce financial risks and better manage your assets. Here are some risk management tools and methods worth considering:

  1. Insurance: Purchasing appropriate insurance is the most basic and important risk management tool. Health insurance, car insurance, property insurance, life insurance, etc., can provide you with economic support and protection when accidents or disasters occur.

  2. Diversified Portfolio: When investing, spreading funds across different asset classes, such as stocks, bonds, real estate, and cash, helps to diversify risk. Such a diversified portfolio can reduce losses when specific assets perform poorly.
item.content:encoded:
When dealing with risk management, there are many useful tools and methods that can help you reduce financial risks and better manage your assets. Here are some risk management tools and methods worth considering:

  1. Insurance: Purchasing appropriate insurance is the most basic and important risk management tool. Health insurance, car insurance, property insurance, life insurance, etc., can provide you with economic support and protection when accidents or disasters occur.

  2. Diversified Portfolio: When investing, spreading funds across different asset classes, such as stocks, bonds, real estate, and cash, helps to diversify risk. Such a diversified portfolio can reduce losses when specific assets perform poorly.

  3. Emergency Savings Fund: Establishing an emergency savings fund is used to cope with sudden emergencies and unexpected expenses. It is usually recommended to save an amount equivalent to three to six months of living expenses as an emergency reserve.

  4. Stop-Loss Strategy: In investing, setting a stop-loss point is a common risk management method. By setting a price point, assets are automatically sold when the asset price falls to a certain degree, thus avoiding further losses.

  5. Professional Financial Advisor: Seeking the help of a professional financial advisor or wealth planner can help you formulate personalized risk management strategies and make reasonable plans based on your goals and risk tolerance.

  6. Long-Term Investment: Long-term investment is usually more stable than short-term speculation because it can smoothly handle market fluctuations and achieve more stable returns through the accumulation of time.

  7. Healthy Lifestyle: Maintaining a healthy lifestyle helps reduce medical costs and health risks. Regular physical examinations and maintaining healthy eating habits can reduce the possibility of illness.

  8. Compliance with Laws and Regulations: Adhering to laws and regulations, including traffic rules and building safety standards, can reduce many potential property and liability risks.

  9. Education Planning: Planning for your children’s education in advance helps to distribute the pressure of future educational expenses.

  10. Debt Management: Managing personal debt ensures that the debt burden is reasonable and does not exceed your capacity to bear it.

In summary, risk management is a crucial part of personal financial planning. By using appropriate tools and methods, you can better protect your and your family’s financial security and plan for the future more effectively.

3 Are there truly investment assets that only rise and never fall?

Highlight(yellow) - Location 260

Therefore, Warren Buffett always recommends that ordinary people buy the S&P 500 index fund—in China, the corresponding asset for the S&P 500 is the CSI 300 index fund. The advantage of index funds is that they are essentially equivalent to “following the market.” You don’t have to bet on the luck of a single company; instead, you bet on the luck of the entire nation, or the luck of the entire world—in any case, in the long run, the scale of the human economy is constantly growing. Look, as long as it is long-term, it suddenly stops being a gamble, because in the long run, risk can actually be diluted to the point of near elimination.

4 The only correct way for ordinary people to invest.

Highlight(yellow) - Location 359

People who “go all in” (put everything on the line) cannot endure pain for too long—in fact, no one can endure pain long-term. This has absolutely nothing to do with so-called “strength.” From another perspective, this isn’t foolishness; it’s merely ignorance. After a month, or two months, or three months of pain, even when looking back, when they feel they are about to get through it, that is, around the sixth month (or slightly before), many people will exit for various reasons—in the trading market, this behavior is called “cutting the meat” (or “cutting losses”). Look, the leeks (investors) cut themselves, and what they cut off is bloody meat.

5 Why few people use the DCA strategy.

Highlight(yellow) - Location 387

6 The profound mechanism behind the magical power of the DCA strategy.

Highlight(yellow) - 6.1. Everyone should cultivate their proactive personality > Location 472

Highlight(yellow) - 6.1. Everyone should cultivate their proactive personality > Location 482

Stay away from those who complain all day—they don’t know what they are doing. They will complain about unfairness with righteous indignation and great spirit, as if Heaven itself is on their side. They never want to know the truth: this world is simply unfair. Using more accurate, unbiased, humble yet confident terms to describe it, this world is full of asymmetry, just as this world is full of uncertainty.

Highlight(yellow) - 6.2. Most proactive people actually don’t know their boundaries > Location 540

As parents themselves, their own future will not improve; their children unconsciously become “people who have always been passive toward themselves.” The correct choice should originally be: parents should proactively make themselves better and better; causing the children to desire improvement out of envy, and thus the children will take the initiative, even if it is merely superficial imitation, which is a good start.

Highlight(yellow) - 6.4. The optimal strategy for riding the trend must be proactive passivity > Location 636

Whether a decision is significant or meaningful, just look at one metric: Is it a choice aligned with the trend?

Highlight(yellow) - 6.4. The optimal strategy for riding the trend must be proactive passivity > Location 665

The longer the investment cycle, the greater the advantage of passivity; the larger the investment amount, the greater the advantage of passivity.

The truth has no obligation to cater to your emotions.

If you feel desperate, it is merely because you are currently poor. If your feeling is very desperate, it is merely because you are truly poor.

Highlight(yellow) - 6.8. The long-term perspective determines your result > Location 872

The poorer you are, the more patience you need. What is courage? Courage is the only virtue that cannot be faked.

Highlight(yellow) - 6.8. The long-term perspective determines your result > Location 903

One rise is not a trend, and one fall is not a trend; one rise plus one fall constitutes a cycle; judging the trend requires at least two cycles. After two cycles, the two fluctuations formed can only be one of three trends: rising, horizontal, or falling.

Highlight(yellow) - 6.9. What extreme advantage do ordinary people possess? > Location 992

More than ten years ago, I occasionally heard two middle managers from a large company discussing how to make their subordinates obedient: “Alas, how did you manage to make them obedient? I’m really worried!"—Isn’t it simple? Organize a group of wives to go look at houses together! Let me tell you, don’t look down on them now that they are acting so powerful in front of you; as long as they buy a house, paying the down payment today, tomorrow they are mine! No doubt about it!

7 The difference between foolishness and ignorance, and passive intelligence.

Highlight(yellow) - Location 1068

8 Some people are always on the correct side.

Highlight(yellow) - Location 1147

Highlight(yellow) - Location 1178

For all ordinary people, the DCA strategy is absolutely feasible, completely genuine, and relies entirely on yourself. The “ordinary people” referred to here are not distinguished by race, nationality, region, gender, age, height, weight, beauty, or ugliness, nor by sexual orientation… The key is that they are not even distinguished by IQ and education level!

9 The common appearance on the other side of the mirror world.

Highlight(yellow) - Location 1202

Their explanations are always astonishingly consistent: “Alas, I am just too greedy!”

Highlight(yellow) - Location 1210

Highlight(yellow) - Location 1226

Highlight(yellow) - Location 1249

10 DCA is the essential choice for ordinary people.

Highlight(yellow) - Location 1296

There are three conditions that determine a person’s wealth: background, luck, and effort; and among these three, effort is the most insignificant.

Highlight(yellow) - Location 1337

Conclusion

Highlight(yellow) - Location 1405

Within your proactive boundary, continuously strengthen your psychological construction and desperately find ways to make money outside the market; at the same time, outside the proactive boundary, proactively choose an asset absolutely worth holding long-term, and use the money you earned outside the market to invest regularly… Over time, you can harness the magical passive power generated by the trend, not only potentially break free from the shackles of class solidification, but even change your destiny—ultimately, gain freedom.

National destiny seems to be a ultimate asset, I should DCA into the S&P 500.

item.title: The Path to Financial Freedom_Li Xiaolai
item.description:
00.20160729 Three Iron Laws of Selling Time ★

Highlight(blue) - Location 163

The three iron laws of selling time: Growth is the fundamental key, prioritize value over valuation, and patience is more important than anything else.

Highlight(blue) - Location 167

The so-called personal financial freedom means that a person no longer has to sell their time just to meet basic living necessities.

Highlight(orange) - Location 203

There is only one standard for selection: Can what I choose help me accumulate more ability?
item.content:encoded:
00.20160729 Three Iron Laws of Selling Time ★

Highlight(blue) - Location 163

The three iron laws of selling time: Growth is the fundamental key, prioritize value over valuation, and patience is more important than anything else.

Highlight(blue) - Location 167

The so-called personal financial freedom means that a person no longer has to sell their time just to meet basic living necessities.

Highlight(orange) - Location 203

There is only one standard for selection: Can what I choose help me accumulate more ability?

Highlight(blue) - Location 204

Now that food delivery is so developed, when I go to pick up takeout, I often think: so many people are selling their time at such cheap prices, and what they are doing is something that has absolutely no accumulation effect. What will they do in the future?

Highlight(blue) - Location 207

If you don’t need to break through, then you don’t need to grow, and you don’t need to learn further. Doing such a job might give you some self-satisfaction (mostly from stability), but because there is no growth, you can never cross a milestone in your lifetime.

Highlight(pink) - Location 245

It is a habit, because the short-term gains from deception are always very high. In the long run, this habit is almost impossible to eradicate. You see, the reason it is hard to adhere to the iron laws is because the temptation to violate them is too great. But looking at it the other way, all deceptions are not permanent; there will always be a day when the truth comes out. From this perspective, the advice given by Dario of Bridgewater is truly wise.

Highlight(pink) - Location 253

People who lack patience are more likely to choose “end-point thinking.” They hope to finish quickly, see results quickly, and then they can enter the world they have imagined. Lack of patience…

01.20160801 Three Major Pitfalls Hindering Financial Freedom ★

Highlight(yellow) - Location 278

  1. You must focus all your most precious attention on your own “growth.” 2. Entrepreneurship is growth. Without growth, it is not entrepreneurship. 3. People who don’t cherish their attention are destined to be poor in the end, because they will be harvested their entire lives, and they will never have truly valuable output. How can they eventually become wealthy?

Highlight(yellow) - Location 291

The first major pitfall is called “randomly joining the fun.”

Highlight(yellow) - Location 298

The online world has even more fun; you can even brew yourself a cup of tea, strike a pose, and watch. Oh! Vanke had an incident! Oh! Wu Yifan had an incident! Oh! Zhao Wei had an incident! Oh… These people are now called “melon-eaters” (spectators) online. Compared to those watching on the roadside, online spectators turn joining the fun into a farce—a group of people are inexplicably watching, and as they watch, the spectators start arguing with each other, attracting even more people… It is said that curiosity is the source of creativity. Look, in fact, everyone has abundant curiosity. Unfortunately, it is wasted on watching inexplicable fun. However, this is also right…

Highlight(yellow) - Location 305

The second major pitfall is called “rushing to follow the trend.” Suddenly, a certain “trend” appears. For example, the recent “content entrepreneurship,” or last year’s “O2O”… Something is hot! Instantly, a large group of people (in fact, always the vast majority) rush to follow the trend… But they forget that whenever a major trend appears, there is always another group of people who were already prepared—even if they weren’t intentionally prepared. If content entrepreneurship is truly a trend, a major tide, then the group of people who have been writing for ten years before this are clearly “unintentionally but inevitably the most prepared.” The people who just started rushing, how can they compete with the other group?

Highlight(yellow) - Location 318

The third major pitfall is called “worrying about others’ hearts.”

Highlight(yellow) - Location 330

—A saying: You are a mud Bodhisattva, unable to cross even a small river, yet you worry about others’ hearts. Truly, what are you aiming for? If someone fails in their business, you won’t suffer a loss, but if someone succeeds, you are afraid, aren’t you?

Highlight(yellow) - Location 345

Money is not the most important thing because it can regenerate; time is also not the most important thing because it essentially doesn’t belong to you. You can only try to be friends with it and make it work for you. Your attention is the most important and precious resource you possess—viewed from this angle, life is actually fair, because your attention is something you can control yourself, unless you give it up. So, whether the outcome is good or bad, it is truly up to you.

Note - Location 348

Attention

Highlight(blue) - Location 351

This might be the most valuable advice in life—because, ultimately, all your value is the output of your attention. Moreover, more critically, a person’s attention is likely the only resource that can be called “innate” and productive. Think about it, what else is like this?… Where should it be placed? The answer is clear and unique: placed on “growth.” There is a Silicon Valley “cliché” that is actually very meaningful: “Entrepreneurship is growth. Without growth, it is not entrepreneurship.”

Highlight(blue) - Location 359

If you want to go one step further, you can try listing the following (this is not homework): 1. Review what you have been paying attention to? List them, and judge whether those things are related to you? Are they related to your growth? 2. Review what you have been paying attention to last week? List them? Judge whether those things are related to you? Are they related to your growth? 3. Review what you have been paying attention to last month… I know you probably can’t remember it?

Highlight(blue) - Location 365

In a sense, advertising is actually this kind of business model, isn’t it? You can study the major marketing accounts on Weibo; they are best at “attracting attention”—another way of saying “harvesting cheap or free attention.” Then look at how many people are even “voluntarily contributing their attention,” and then you can understand why this business model can ultimately achieve “long-lasting prosperity.”

Highlight(pink) - Location 370

If you dare to ignore your attention, your attention (in fact, your attention is the truly valuable you) will be ruthlessly harvested and sold.

Highlight(yellow) - Location 373

People who don’t cherish their attention are destined to be poor in the end, because they will be harvested their entire lives, and they will never have truly valuable output. How can they eventually become wealthy?

01.20160805 Our Most Important Wealth is “Attention” ★

Highlight(blue) - Location 385

Keywords: Accumulation Effect, Key to Happiness, Individual Value 1. When some people ask why their schedule is packed yet they still feel they have no gain, I remind them: the packed thing is your time; the idle thing is your attention; the wasted thing is your growth. 2. Put your attention on your own growth. Put it on skills that can have an accumulation effect, and then give them sufficient learning, thinking, and refinement. 3. Put your attention on true love without expecting return; this is the key to true happiness. 4. Put your attention on things that truly contribute to society. Individual value equals one’s social contribution rate.

Highlight(blue) - Location 425

The wasted thing is your growth.

Highlight(yellow) - Location 455

Reasons for falling into the three major attention pitfalls: For most people, short-term pleasure is more useful than long-term gain. It satisfies personal so-called security, belonging, and achievement.

02.20160812 Paying is Picking Up Bargains ★

Highlight(blue) - Location 463

  1. What bargains have you picked up by paying in the past period? Not just this channel—this channel is super valuable, without a doubt. 2. In the past period, where have you wasted time and attention in places where you could have picked up bargains? 3. In the past period, how many times have you been in a bad mood all day because of an argument with family? 4. If you need continuous attention but are repeatedly disturbed, have you thought of any effective countermeasures? 5. Where have you ignored the value order of assets, to the point where you suffered a big loss?

Highlight(yellow) - Location 471

What resource is most important? (Attention) What resource is more important? (Attention > Time > Money)

Highlight(yellow) - Location 479

Many people comment, saying they don’t know what to do with their attention. O Accumulate knowledge O Refine skills O Observe life O Think about the future O Create value O Manage relationships

Highlight(yellow) - Location 512

Things to guard against.

Highlight(yellow) - Location 513

So, I have long invented my own method: always set the phone to silent, and turn off all push notifications. When I am focused on working, I should not accept any disturbance. When I stop and rest, I can handle the unread messages and missed calls.

Highlight(pink) - Location 527

Because overall, paying money to buy time is more worthwhile!

Highlight(pink) - Location 557

The best way to make others approach you is to occasionally do something admirable.

03.20160819 The Heaviest Shackle of Life is “Security” ★

Highlight(blue) - Location 561

  1. Almost all progress is achieved by giving up some security. 2. Pursuing 100% security will definitely trap you in the eternal present. 3. We must give up some security to deeply observe and think long-term. 4. Don’t cooperate with people who lack security—because in their world, a true cooperative relationship is actually impossible. 5. Regarding reading, put your attention on how to apply the knowledge gained to improve your life.

Highlight(yellow) - Location 573

Most people are like this: constantly paying attention to everything around them that can be paid attention to, and they are very afraid that they might miss something. They cannot concentrate long-term, nor can they think deeply long-term; their attention is always focused on every event happening around them. Such people have no past, and no future; they don’t even know that they could have a past and a future. For them, there is only the present without comparison.

Highlight(yellow) - Location 580

Ultimately, this may lead to being trapped in the eternal present.

Highlight(yellow) - Location 583

In a sense: almost all progress is achieved by giving up some security.

Highlight(orange) - Location 588

…rather, it is to pursue the security of “not being left behind by the times.” Believe it or not, look around you at how many people are pursuing 100% security. They are constantly attracted by everything happening around them; they cannot deeply observe or deeply think about anything—this might not be their nature, but it is simply that they themselves haven’t realized the limitations of this survival mode—they are like those animals, trapped in the eternal present.

Highlight(orange) - Location 604

One of them is not taking risks.

Highlight(orange) - Location 616

What is cooperation? The essence of cooperation is that everyone gives up a small part of their security and entrusts that part of security to the partner. What is trust? Trust is believing that the other party will not exploit the part of security you voluntarily give up.

Highlight(orange) - Location 623

The so-called lack of security is actually not believing that others can refrain from exploiting the part of security you give up, so they must secure 100% themselves—this is truly an exhausting state, isn’t it? If you know what the root of people’s lack of security is, you will understand why this advice is correct: don’t cooperate with people who lack security—because in their world, a true cooperative relationship is actually impossible.

Highlight(orange) - Location 646

100% security brings 100% constraint.

Highlight(orange) - Location 647

Your time and attention are fleeting; try not to waste them on rapidly depreciating information.

04.20160826 The Foundation of Life: “Having a Future” ★

Highlight(blue) - Location 691

Once you learn it, start doing it; if you can’t learn it, then you should have continued learning… But the vast majority of people choose “let it go” here. There is an even harsher and more frustrating situation: you know how to do it, and even every step is clear, but you just don’t do it, or haven’t done it; it’s not that you don’t want to do it, but “it’s not today, it’s tomorrow”? The most frustrating situation is this: you haven’t failed to do it, you have done it, done it a long time ago, but you just haven’t continued doing it…

item.title: The sense of ceremony makes people focus more on form and ignore content.
item.description: People who highly value the sense of ceremony are those who prioritize form over content—these kinds of people tend to be quite vain and concerned with what others think.

item.title: You must take care of your health. / Take good care of yourself.
item.description:
When a person is in an unhealthy state, it not only severely affects their life but also makes them vulnerable. Many difficulties can usually be pushed through by gritting one’s teeth, but for someone whose body is unhealthy, psychological collapse is very easy. When young, people often don’t take their health seriously, and only when they face problems do they deeply regret it.

If your body has minor ailments, undergo regular check-ups and actively seek treatment. Losing health means that living itself becomes a form of torture. If you are unhealthy, having a lot of things doesn’t hold much significance.

item.title: What school teaches us is for dealing with intelligent people, but what we face in real life are things that cannot be reasoned with.
item.description: If a person lacks the corresponding genes and a good education acquired later in life, then these types of people can never communicate through “reasoning.” They can only accept this objective fact, and they must, like zoologists studying animal habits, figure out the behavioral characteristics of other humans, treating them as a common animal, and using various means to control them and achieve their own goals.

item.title: No matter what you are thinking about, the most important thing is to clearly understand what kind of framework needs to be built right from the start.
item.description: Regardless of what you are thinking about, the most important thing is to figure out what kind of framework you need to build from the start. In fact, once you have the framework, all you need to do next is fill it in. Conversely, if you don’t have a framework and immediately start thinking about the details, you will inevitably face a pile of unstructured and disorganized information, wasting time for nothing.

item.title: 一些常见的错误痛点
item.description: You built a solution for customers who think they have that problem under control. You solved the wrong problem. You developed a solution that helps only at the margins. You solved the wrong problem. You built something, but your customers have bigger fish to fry. You solved the wrong problem.

You solved the wrong problem. You built something, but your customers have bigger fish to fry. You solved the wrong problem.

item.title: 你需要解决的是妨碍他们的核心问题
item.description: You want to build a “need-to-have” instead of a “nice-to-have.” You want to develop a painkiller instead of a vitamin. You want to be their aspirin. How can this be done? By finding their most important problem: the one issue that is critical to their success.
item.content:encoded: You want to build a “need-to-have” instead of a “nice-to-have.” You want to develop a painkiller instead of a vitamin. You want to be their aspirin. How can this be done? By finding their most important problem: the one issue that is critical to their success.

item.title: 什么样的问题算核心问题?
item.description: The most crucial problem a customer faces is on their minds most often. It’s the most important because it’s coming up frequently and is never easy to solve. It has the most impact on their lives, but it’s not always the obvious choice. If you can help a customer with their most critical problem, they will benefit the most.

It has the most impact on their lives, but it’s not always the obvious choice. If you can help a customer with their most critical problem, they will benefit the most.

item.title: 关键痛点是非常痛苦且你无法逃避,必须面对的问题
item.description: A Critical Problem Is Painful Problems can be a nuisance. They come up, and you either deal with them or ignore them. We can’t ignore critical problems. They persistently make the lives of those who have them harder until they are resolved. They can’t be just ignored, because they consistently reduce the quality of life.

item.title: 关键痛点让生活品质下降
item.description: Find the critical problem where ignoring something causes a lower quality of life.

item.title: Key pain points often involve wasted time or wasted money, for example, writing daily reports.
item.description:
Find the critical problem at the intersection of something mandatory and something wasteful.
The critical problem always lies at the intersection of mandatory and wasteful.

Find the critical problem at the intersection of something mandatory and something wasteful.

item.title: 关键痛的点往往是不想干又不得不干的问题
item.description:
A Critical Problem Is Not Optional Some things can be ignored or delegated, but a critical problem can’t be. If it’s critical, people will have to deal with the problem every time it occurs. They can’t just opt out of it. Solving the problem is essential to making any kind of progress in the work.
Find the critical problem where people would love to opt out, but can’t.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: 关键痛点每一次都消耗你不少时间
item.description:
Find the critical problem where solving a problem takes a long time every time the problem occurs.

A Critical Problem Takes up Too Much Time If a problem can be solved quickly, people either solve it the moment it appears or they set aside some time to do the work in a batch later, without feeling like it’s a waste of time. If that is the case, the problem is not really critical. Only when you need to spend considerable time and effort each time you solve the problem will it be impossible to “just” deal with it. “Doing it later” also turns into a chore, as it may take hours or days to deal with a long queue of deferred problems. A critical problem will feel like an unwelcome chore: important, yet tiresome.

item.title: 发现痛点最直接的方式就是和他们聊聊
item.description: Finding the Critical Problem So, how can you learn about which is the most critical problem your customers have? It’s quite straightforward: talk to them. Ask them what annoys them most. Find out where they want to be. Ask them what keeps them from being the best at what they are doing.

item.title: 如果你能帮他们多赚钱，或者能帮他们节约时间，他们会愿意打开钱包
item.description: If you find something that will obviously make them significantly more money or save them a lot of time, then you have something to go on. Customers should really want to pay for it, almost have a burning desire to open their wallets. When they ask you if that is possible and you tell them it is, their mouth should drop to the floor.

item.title: 直接询问客户想要什么产品是不行的，你需要知道他们在用过你的产品后会达到什么状态来判断
item.description: Focus on what you can help them accomplish. Ask what customers want and which state they want to be in when the work is done. Don’t focus too much on the “how it’s done.” That is usually more based on tradition than on an optimized process.

item.title: 浪费时间是最大的痛苦
item.description: Time-Related Pains Most productivity-related issues cause temporal pain: people feel like they’re wasting time. These pains are caused by suboptimal processes and friction between tasks. If tedious work takes a lot of time, it keeps you from doing important and useful things instead. That leads to time mismanagement and relevant actions not being taken. By solving the time-related problem, productive tasks can be accomplished faster and sooner. When people complain about inefficiencies, tedium, or pointless work, you’re looking at a time-related problem.

item.title: 浪费钱也是一种痛苦
item.description: If you hear people complaining about a waste of money, prohibitive costs, compliance, or the wrong people working on the wrong things, you’ve found a resource-related problem.

item.title: 个人焦虑也是痛点，罗振宇做的便是这个生意
item.description: Self-Related Pains This group of problems is often overlooked. Everyone wants to be notable somewhere. This can mean holding a position in a company or being regarded as a supportive co-worker or friend. When people struggle with achieving these things, they feel self-related pains. The four essential concepts to look out for here are Reputation, Accomplishment, Advancement, and Empowerment.

We think deeply about a problem, mentally shape a product, and see how much it would benefit the quality of life. Then we get to work and build the prototype, eager to release it as soon as possible.

item.title: 问出正确的问题，关注问题本身而不是解决方案
item.description: Asking the Right Questions: Focus on Problems not Solutions When you talk to your customers or prospects, you will find that there are questions that always produce meaningful results: where they are now? Where do they want to be? What stands in the way of getting there? Essentially, this is applying the jobs-to-be-done framework to your communication strategy, trying to find their realistic and aspirational states, and then building a solution that allows them to go from one state to the other.

item.title: 细分市场的一些共性
item.description: What unites all niches is that they are inclusive of some and exclusive of others. The members of the in-group will be reasonably similar, depending on the specificity of the niche. That’s why niches work so well for bootstrapped businesses: if you can provide a tool that solves a niche problem very well, you can be sure that everyone in the niche will be interested in it.

item.title: Niche的营销绝应当精细化面对小众人群
item.description: A craft beer company might put up flyers in a local pub that is serving lots of craft beers, or allocate a budget to exhibiting at beer festivals. A niche business will market to its niche and no one else.

item.title: 从一个目标中，你通常可以推断出一个阻碍他成功之路的问题
item.description: From a goal, you can usually infer a problem that is in the way of your customers’ path to success. Solve that problem, and you can help everyone in the niche reach their goals.

item.title: 同一个Niche人群一定是有一些共同的问题，如果你花时间找到这些问题并解决，那你就能启动一个生意了
item.description: People in your niche will likely have the same problems. If they love fantasy football, they all need to keep track of their teams. If they enjoy fly-fishing, they all need to find information on where to fish and how the weather will impact their chances of a catch. If you spend enough time investigating the problems of your niche, you will sooner or later surface their critical problems. These are the things that are common roadblocks for everyone in the niche. Solving that problem with a dedicated product will allow you to have a high chance of success with your bootstrapped business.

Additional exposure and reach results in quick win-win situations, where both partners can significantly boost both their customer base and their reputation as an expert in the niche. Partnering up with other players in the niche allows you to reach customers at different stages of “niche proficiency,” increasing the breadth of your sales funnel.

item.description: A bootstrapped business works best when it starts out in a niche. Most companies will do really well by just staying there. Some expand into other markets. But that initial audience is one of the most important things to carefully select when you start a business.

item.description:
Is the Audience Large Enough? Your audience will have to be big enough to sustain your business. It will likely also have to support competitors, as any successful business will attract competition.
Is the Audience Small Enough? Contrary to popular belief, I think that for a bootstrapped company, in particular, some markets can be too big. Some audiences are too generic, some industries too vast for a great niche to exist. At least, in the beginning, you should have a clearly defined niche. As a bootstrapped entrepreneur, you will reach out to customers and be in direct contact.

From here you can build out your product and marketing strategies for that market.

item.title: To B 业务是基本不可能的,因为大企业怕你突然不干了,大企业需要稳定
item.description: Enterprise markets are hard to sell into for a small company, although it’s not impossible. Purchasing decisions take a long time, there are a lot of requirements even to be considered, and contracts tend to be custom and require a lot of work. Many enterprise customers won’t buy from small companies out of fear they will vanish within a few years, and that fear is not unfounded. In fact, even for your own bootstrapped business, I would recommend against using services offered by companies smaller than yourself. You will be better off looking for a market that is comprised of small to medium-sized businesses and self-employed freelancers.

You also need to validate that this is an actual problem that people need to have addressed. Sometimes, we just want to complain, but we don’t want to change our ways. You will need to find a problem so painful that we just have to deal with it.

item.title: What should I do when the boss always assigns me miscellaneous tasks/grunt work?
item.description:
First, categorize things, and ensure that the core KPIs consume at least 60% or more of your time and effort. If other miscellaneous tasks take up more than this, then communicate with your manager/leader. Don’t complain that you have too much work; instead, tell your manager that you are concerned about the completion rate and quality of your core KPIs being affected.

Usually, your manager gives you temporary miscellaneous tasks without fully considering your workload; they might just assign them arbitrarily, or they might think that giving them to you is fine—don’t let it slide.

item.title: Imitation is the most efficient shortcut.
item.description:
Repetition is the mother of success. Over 90% of success comes from imitation and repetition, rather than from innovation.

The reason a person doesn’t want to do repetitive things is usually this: they haven’t succeeded at anything yet, so they lack successful experience.

Imitation is the most efficient shortcut.

Whether you are studying by imitating top students, working by imitating excellent employees, creating products by imitating bestsellers, or doing self-media by imitating internet celebrities, the path leads to the same destination.

item.title: 发现了一个群体的集体痛点
item.description:
We found out that many other teachers did the same when they started talking about their self-built solutions in their online communities. Teachers began to share their templates through Google sheets. It was clear that this was a shared problem in a very tight-knit community.

There was a sizeable market with an apparent, shared, and critical problem. The problem was solvable, but no one had yet built anything to make it noticeably easier.

item.title: 没有客户的产品一文不值
item.description:
A business would be nothing without customers. You can have the best product in the world, but you won’t be able to build any meaningful business if there is no one to pay for what you offer.

Who am I helping? You will discover how to find the perfect niche and make sure it can support your business in Step One: Your Audience. Why do they need help? Learn how to find and validate their critical problem in Step Two: Their Problem. How can I help them with that? Find a good solution and make sure it fits into your prospective customers’ workflow in Step Three: Your Solution. What can I create to help them that way? You’ll learn how to create an easy-to-maintain and reliable product in Step Four: Your Product.

item.title: Free thinking is more important than speaking freely.
item.description: Draw a clear line between thought and speech. Have every thought in your mind, but you don’t necessarily have to say it out loud. I encourage myself to silently think those most audacious thoughts in my head. Your mind is an underground organization; absolutely do not tell outsiders everything that happens there. The first rule of the “Fighting Club” is not to mention the Fighting Club.

item.title: In any competitive environment, if you can see what others cannot or dare not see, you have a great advantage.
item.description: People with higher intelligence are more willing to contemplate groundbreaking and unconventional ideas. This is not merely because smart people actively seek out the flaws in traditional concepts, but also because traditional concepts have little constraining power over them, making it easy for them to break free. You can see this in their clothing: those who are not constrained by traditional ideas often do not wear popular fashion.

item.title: Keep quiet, welcome with a smile.
item.description:
Don’t let yourself become a part of the crowd; instead, try to stay as far away from the crowd as possible, observe what is happening, and pay special attention to the suppressed thoughts and views.

If a proposition is not wrong, but is labeled with various tags and subjected to suppression and criticism, then there is a problem. Because as long as it is not a wrong view, it should not be suppressed in discussion. Therefore, whenever you see certain statements being attacked as originating from the XX faction or XX ideology, this is a clear signal that there is an issue behind it. This is true whether it is in 1630 or 2030. When you hear someone using such labels, you must ask why.

If you want to think clearly, you must stay away from the crowd. However, the farther you go, the more difficult your situation will become, and the greater the resistance you will face, because you are not conforming to social customs, but are going against them step by step. In childhood, everyone encourages you to grow continuously, to become a mentally mature person who no longer throws childish tantrums. But few people encourage you to continue growing, to become a person who is skeptical and resists the wrong social trends. If you yourself are part of the tide, how can you see the direction of the tide? You can only maintain skepticism forever. Ask yourself: what words can I not say? Why?

item.title: In the city, the bandits committed no offense whatsoever. Zi Cheng decreed: To kill one person is equivalent to killing my father; to defile one person is equivalent to raping my mother.
item.description: Is Li Zicheng ultimately a rebel leader, or a leader of a righteous army? This question is difficult to answer. In fact, Li Zicheng has always been a good leader of a violent faction. As the head of a violent group, Li Zicheng has consistently pursued the maximization of “blood return” (xuèchóu). Bandits burn, kill, and plunder, seeking to maximize one-time blood return; after entering the city, they commit no offense, seeking to maximize long-term legal blood return.

item.title: Law of Blood Compensation
item.description: The prerequisite for robbery is that there must be something to steal; the prerequisite for kidnapping and demanding ransom is that the hostage must have the financial capacity to pay the ransom. As the Law of Blood Payment (or Law of Life Compensation) states, the value of the hostage’s life is determined by the willingness and ability of the parties to pay the ransom. Under conditions of equal risk and cost, the richer the hostage, and the wealthier the target of the robbery, the higher the profit from the kidnapping and robbery. Conversely, the poorer the target of the robbery and kidnapping, the lower the profit from the robbery. If the profit is so low that it is not worth the effort, the bandits cannot proceed.

item.title: To maximize short-term violent income (or "blood-reward income"), legal violent groups can degenerate into bandits.
item.description: The warlord zones of the late Qing Dynasty frequently changed hands, implementing a policy of “killing the chicken to take the eggs” (killing the goose to get the gander/harvesting immediately), but the negative consequences might not necessarily be borne by oneself, and strength can still be bolstered. Implementing a policy of “raising the chicken to lay eggs” (nurturing for future gain), one might not necessarily be able to eat the eggs in the future, and the chickens might be stolen and eaten by others; the current malnutrition could also rapidly lead to collapse. Within this framework, “draining the marsh to catch the fish” (exhausting resources for immediate gain) — the standard behavior of bandits/marauders — is the most advantageous choice.

item.title: Throughout all dynasties and generations, ancient and modern, domestic and international, it is all disaster springing from the mouth.
item.description:
If one could ride a time machine back to the past, no matter which era, one thing would remain unchanged: “misfortune comes from the mouth” (or “words bring disaster”). You must be careful about what you say.

Words that seem harmless can bring you great trouble.

Today, saying that the Earth revolves around the Sun is utterly commonplace. But if you said that in 17th-century Europe, you would be in serious trouble.
item.content:encoded:
If one could ride a time machine back to the past, no matter which era, one thing would remain unchanged: “misfortune comes from the mouth” (or “words bring disaster”). You must be careful about what you say.

Words that seem harmless can bring you great trouble.

Today, saying that the Earth revolves around the Sun is utterly commonplace. But if you said that in 17th-century Europe, you would be in serious trouble.

Galileo said those words, and as a result, he faced judgment from the religious court.

Nerds/Bookworms are the kind of people who get into trouble like that.

They wear unpopular clothes and speak inappropriate words.

They feel they have expressed the correct viewpoint, but in reality, they attract trouble.

The power of custom is not enough to restrain them.

The norm of history seems to be that people in any era firmly believe in some absurd things.

Their beliefs are very strong; as long as someone shows even a slight doubt, they will attract great trouble. Is our era different? If you have read a little history, you know the answer is almost certainly “no difference.”

Even if there is that tiny possibility, for the first time in history, that all the beliefs of our era are correct, it is due to astonishing coincidence, not because we have truly found the correct direction.

When one thinks that what we assert with certainty now is seen as absurd by people in the future, how can one not be amazed!

item.title: If others tell you what you should believe, and you genuinely believe it, then you will make the same mistake as others.
item.description:
Perhaps things are not so coincidental; your viewpoint was heard from someone else. Whatever others told you, you believed it, and you treated the views that others instilled in you as your own.

Sometimes, others will tell you, “You must modify your thinking according to social needs (well-adjusted).” The implied meaning of this statement seems to be that if you don’t agree with society, then it must definitely be your own problem. Do you agree with this statement? In fact, it is not only incorrect, but it also causes history to regress. If you truly believe it, and for anything that disagrees with society, you don’t even dare to think about it, immediately giving up your own viewpoint, that is when the real problem occurs.

item.title: What is it that we cannot say?
item.description:
First, we can look at how people get into trouble because of what they say.

Only if two conditions are met simultaneously.

The first condition is that the words cannot be said;

The second condition is that they are correct, or seem likely to be correct and are worth further discussion. If the second condition is not met, in most cases, you won’t have trouble.

If you say that 2+2 equals 5, or that the average height of a citizen in Pittsburgh is three meters, you won’t have any issues. These obviously incorrect statements might be taken as a joke, or worse, as proof that you are crazy, but they certainly won’t anger anyone.
